description.en: Fades characters in or out over _frm frames and waits for the fade. With _alpha above 0: alpha to 0, show, fade to _alpha, wait. Otherwise: fade from 1.0 to _alpha, wait, then hide. The stand scenes use it to bring the two speakers in before the dialogue and out after it.
Character handle or array of handles.
Target alpha: 1.0 to fade in, 0.0 to fade out.
Length of the fade in frames.

examples.case: Bringing two speakers in, talking, and taking them out (real usage, from ev42010600.nut)
